name: gizza-ai/mel-spectrogram-generator
summary: Render audio as a PNG mel spectrogram for ML debugging

tool.description: Render an uploaded or pasted audio file as a mel-scaled PNG spectrogram. The tool decodes common audio containers locally, downmixes or selects a channel, optionally resamples, applies an STFT, triangular mel filterbank, dB/power scaling and a selectable colormap. It returns an image envelope plus a short report with the resolved FFT, hop, sample rate, mel bands, peak band and PNG size.

center.description: Reflect-pad by n_fft/2 before framing, matching librosa center=True (default). Turn off for only complete in-file frames.

channel.description: Audio channel selection before analysis: mix (default downmix to mono), left, or right. Mono sources fall back to their only channel.

colormap.description: Color palette for the PNG: magma (default), inferno, viridis, plasma, turbo, grayscale, or grayscale_inverted.

db_reference.description: dB reference for scale=db: peak maps the clip's loudest cell to the top color (default); full_scale keeps quiet clips visibly dimmer.

fmax.description: Highest mel filter edge in Hz (0-24000, default 0 = Nyquist for the analysis sample rate). Values above Nyquist are clamped.

fmin.description: Lowest mel filter edge in Hz (0-24000, default 0). Raise it to ignore rumble or telephone-band low cut.

height.description: Output height in pixels (0 = one row per mel band, otherwise 32-2048; default 400).

hop_length.description: Samples between adjacent STFT frames (0 = n_fft/4, default 512 when n_fft is 2048). Smaller hops make a wider, denser image.

input.description: Audio file bytes encoded as base64 or hex. Decodes WAV, AIFF, CAF, FLAC, MP3, OGG/Vorbis, MP4/M4A, MKV/WebM and AAC-ADTS; the selected channel is rendered as a PNG mel spectrogram. Limit 24 MiB input bytes and 4,000,000 decoded samples.

input_format.description: Encoding used for the pasted audio bytes: base64 (default) or hex. The standalone page fills this from the uploaded file automatically.

mel_scale.description: Mel frequency formula: slaney (default, librosa-style area-normalized filters) or htk (classic 2595*log10 scale).

n_fft.description: FFT and analysis-window size in samples (64-8192, default 2048). Larger windows sharpen frequency detail but blur time detail.

n_mels.description: Number of triangular mel bands before image scaling (8-512, default 128). Common ML front ends use 64, 80 or 128 bands.

resample_hz.description: Resample before analysis (0 = keep the source rate, otherwise 4000-48000 Hz). Use 16000 or 22050 to match common ML pipelines.

scale.description: Pixel scaling: db (default log/dB spectrogram), power (linear mel power), or magnitude (square-root power).

top_db.description: Dynamic range shown below the reference level when scale=db (10-160 dB, default 80). Lower values increase contrast.

width.description: Output width in pixels (0 = one pixel per STFT frame, otherwise 32-4096; default 1000).

window.description: Window applied before each FFT: hann (default), hamming, blackman, or rectangular/no taper.
